pairings.ourName: Ananya College of Medicine & Research, Kalol, Gandhinagar
pairings.evidence: Only 'Ananya' MBBS college in the NMC registry (Gujarat, est. 2023, 150 seats, Gujarat University). The 2023 row's city cell reads 'Ahmedabad' (address '1050 G Block, KIRC Education Campus'), but NMC's own Revised UG Seat Matrix 2024-25 lists it as 'Ananya College of Medicine & Research, Kalol', district Gandhinagar, management Private, 2023, 150 — matching our record exactly. City taken as Gandhinagar (the newer NMC document + our record), not the stale 2023 city cell.

pairings.ourName: Dr. Kiran C. Patel Medical College & Research Institute, Bharuch
pairings.nmcName: Dr.Kiran C.Patel Medical College and Research Institute
pairings.evidence: Same name (only spacing/'&' differ); the 2023 NMC row has an empty address/city but is affiliated to Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, est. 2020, 200 seats, Trust. NMC's Revised UG Seat Matrix 2024-25 gives the district for this exact row as Bharuch — matching our record. Only college of this name in India.

One and the same college under two names: NMC address 'General Hospital Godhra, Cuba Masjid Road, Shahwali Wad, Godhra, Panchmahal-389120', Govt., est. 2022, 100 seats, Shri Govind Guru University Godhra. GMERS Medical College Godhra is the Gujarat Medical Education & Research Society college opened in Godhra in 2022 with 100 MBBS seats under Shri Govind Guru University (https://bodmaseducation.com/gmers-medical-college-godhra). Godhra has only one MBBS college.

NMC address 'Civil Hospital Campus, Sardar Nagar, Morbi-363641', Govt., est. 2022, 100 seats, Saurashtra University Rajkot — identical to GMERS Medical College Morbi (GMERS society college, 2022, 100 MBBS seats, Saurashtra University; https://bodmaseducation.com/gmers-medical-college-morbi). Morbi has only one MBBS college.

NMC address '1, Behind ITI, Porbandar-360575', Govt., est. 2022, 100 seats, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University — identical to GMERS Medical College Porbandar (GMERS society college, 2022, 100 MBBS seats, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University; https://www.bodmaseducation.com/gmers-medical-college-porbandar). Porbandar has only one MBBS college.
